synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — margins/ROIC/North-America softness and unanimous estimate cuts pull bearish, but rising absolute EBITDA, net cash and a compounding AI-native leg counter it.

bull_points.claim: The stock is near the bottom of its own 9-year multiple range — EV/EBITDA 5.4x sits at the 3rd percentile against a trailing median of 22.4x, so the de-rate is a residual overshoot only if the earnings base is intact rather than an earned reset.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Multiples (Close; last col = current, excluded from history)

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA has kept RISING through the de-rate — $652M (FY23) → $693M (FY24) → $707M (FY25) → $753M LTM — so the collapsing multiple is not a collapsing profit pool.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: On fundamentals the name screens BETTER than the peer median on the drivers that usually earn a discount: revenue growth 11% vs 1%, EBITDA growth 5% vs -0%, Debt/EBITDA 0.2 vs 2.1 — posing whether the discount to peers is RESIDUAL rather than EARNED, though the human must judge against a heterogeneous set.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: The balance sheet is net cash (net-debt/EBITDA -0.8x) and the business is FCF-positive on the LTM levered-FCF basis ($650.2M), so this is a self-funding, survivable name, not a distressed one.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Net Debt ÷ CIQ LTM EBITDA (EDGAR XBRL breadth fallback) + FCF sign (survival capacity)

bull_points.claim: Management reports a compounding AI-native revenue leg — pure AI-native revenue reached more than $160M in Q2 2026, an acceleration — which is the mechanism behind the claim that the growth engine is intact under the reported-revenue softness.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 06, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The most recent quarter MET revenue, EBIT and EPS guidance (FQ2 2026) and the delivery track-record is strong (revenue actual ≥ floor 62/63; EPS-normalized 61/62), evidence the reported print is landing at or above guided levels.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Guidance (latest guide + sign-aware delivery track-record) — CIQ states every guide as a LEVEL; where management guided a RATE, the level is CIQ's arithmetic, not the company's published figure

bull_points.claim: The company is shrinking the share count (buying back ~9.1% of shares over ~1.7y), a capital-return signal at a depressed multiple.

bear_points.claim: The de-rate is idiosyncratic, not market-driven: EPAM fell -39.7% over 180d while the mid-cap benchmark rose +8.6%, a -48pt relative gap — the market is repricing this name specifically, not the sector.

The core problem is a real revenue-mechanism deterioration management itself owns: North America is 'not growing fast enough' with demand shifting away from task-based services faster than replacement work ramps, and reported organic constant-currency growth slowed to 3.4% in Q2.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 06, 2026.rtf

bear_points.claim: Gross and EBITDA margins are in secular decline — gross 36% (FY17) → 29% (LTM); EBITDA 17% (FY22) → 13% (LTM) — and the paired absolute-EBITDA reconciler shows the rise is slowing (707 → 753 LTM), so the margin fall is a genuine structural signal, not purely an optical %-vs-absolute mismatch.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: Forward estimates are being cut hard and broadly — Revenue FY2026 revisions 0↑/16↓ last month — confirming the print is deteriorating, not stabilising, so the near-floor multiple sits on a falling forward base.
The big AI-led deals management points to as the offset are explicitly NOT signed and pushed out — meaningful contribution now expected in 1H 2027 rather than 2H 2026 — removing a near-term catalyst.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 06, 2026.rtf

bear_points.claim: Returns on capital have stepped down and stayed down — ROIC 14.9% (FY22) → 9.6% (FY25) → 10.5% LTM — consistent with an earned, not purely optical, reset of the business's economics.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Ratios (Return on Capital %, multi-year columns)

decisive_question.question: Is North America's revenue softness a temporary mix-transition (task-based work retiring faster than AI-led replacement ramps) that the compounding AI-native leg and unsigned large deals will backfill — or a structural, earned reset of EPAM's growth and margin base?

evidence_for.claim: Management frames the North America gap as a self-inflicted, addressable mix and go-to-market timing problem ('we own it'), with AI-native revenue accelerating to >$160M in Q2 as the offsetting engine.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 06, 2026.rtf

evidence_for.claim: Absolute EBITDA continued to rise to $753M LTM even as margins fell, so the profit pool has not yet inflected down.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

evidence_for.claim: Fundamentals still screen ahead of peers on growth (11% vs 1%) and leverage (0.2 vs 2.1), posing the discount as potentially residual.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

evidence_against.claim: The load-bearing offset — the large AI-led deals — is unsigned and now pushed to 1H 2027, leaving 2H 2026 exposed to the North America shortfall.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 06, 2026.rtf

evidence_against.claim: Revenue estimates are being cut almost unanimously (0↑/16↓ last month), signalling the analyst community reads the softness as deepening, not transient.
The multi-year gross-margin slide (36%→29%) and ROIC step-down (14.9%→10.5%) are consistent with an earned reset of the economics.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Ratios (Return on Capital %, multi-year columns)

key_unknowns: Whether the depressed EV/EBITDA is an overshoot or an earned value-trap CANNOT be resolved from a trailing multiple alone — the ev_ebitda fact is flagged trailing-only with no forward basis to distinguish a temporarily depressed level from a permanently impaired one.

No segment-level EBITDA is disclosed — the company reports two revenue segments (Americas; Europe) but no segment profitability, so the margin drag from the underperforming North America business cannot be isolated (a missing expected disclosure).
No adjusted forward EBITDA or adjusted EPS in the revised 99.1 guidance, and net-debt/adjusted-EBITDA is UNKNOWN — the company-defined forward profitability basis is not available.
Interest coverage is UNKNOWN (no period with both EBITDA and interest expense), though net-cash mitigates the relevance.

The peer set is flagged HETEROGENEOUS (market caps span $1.3B–$107.5B, 82x) — every peer-median comparison is a confidence-gated input, not a clean benchmark, and the median is anchored by businesses of differing scale/model.
Whether the unsigned large AI-led deals actually close and ramp on the now-projected 1H 2027 timeline — timing and conversion are unresolved.
Management posture requires reading both earnings-call transcripts in full for the quarter-over-quarter shift in tone on North America and demand visibility.

caveats: Unreconciled margin-compression (a decisive-against point): 'The multi-year gross-margin slide (36%→29%) and ROIC step-down (14.9%→10.5%) are consistent with an earned reset of the economics.' — cites margin compression without the absolute-EBITDA reconciliation (margin % can fall while EBITDA rises)
